items.scope: Vulnerabilities related to TCS-CERT’s customers’ environment and vulnerabilities related to research conducted by Cyber Solutions by Thales’ Intrusion and Application Security Team.
Western Digital products including WD, SanDisk, SanDisk Professional, G-Technology, and HGST only.
Microchip Technology products only.
Projects within The Document Foundation only, e.g., LibreOffice, LibreOffice Online; The Document Foundation discourages reporting denial of service bugs as security issues.
All Bitdefender products, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Bitdefender that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Kong products; Kong Konnect, Kong Enterprise, Kong Mesh, and Kong Insomnia, including Kong Opensource; Kong Gateway, Kuma, Insomnia.
All HashiCorp products and projects unless covered by another CNA’s scope.
Digi branded products and services only.
Citrix issues only.

Any Seagate or LaCie software or hardware, open or closed source, supported and end of life, as well as any vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Seagate that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Zscaler issues only.
All BlackBerry products identified on https://www.blackberry.com/us/en.
All Schneider Electric products, including Proface, APC, and ProLeiT.
All HYPR products only.
Elasticsearch, Kibana, Beats, Logstash, X-Pack, and Elastic Cloud Enterprise products only.

Vulnerabilities in the following Altium products only: Altium Designer, A365, Octopart, and Altium Enterprise Server.

All Acronis products, including Acronis Cyber Protect, Acronis Cyber Protect Home Office, Acronis DeviceLock DLP, and Acronis Snap Deploy.
All vulnerabilities on software products that our company provides, including KNIME Analytics Platform, KNIME Server, and KNIME Hub.
Adobe issues only.

Vulnerabilities in the AHA! website and other AHA! controlled assets, as well as vulnerabilities identified in assets owned, operated, or maintained by another organization unless covered by the scope of another CNA.

Dahua consumer Internet of Things (IoT) products, excludes End-of-Life products.
